One (1) year of clinical experience with direct patient contact.

Perform patient assessment, including giving or receiving report, obtaining the patient history, conducting a physical assessment, establishing priorities for care. Assess patient's learning needs, readiness for discharge and ability to manage illness after discharge.

Completes documentation timely and submits within 24 hours of visit. Contacts Supervisor and updates him/her on patient's progress. Submits schedule weekly and notifies Scheduler of changes as they occur.
Maintains productivity standards as set by the department.
Receive and administer physician orders in a safe and timely manner. Uses hospital/agency approved process for telephone and / or verbal orders.

Develop/implement care plan and/or discharge plan for each patient, including interpreting care paths, physician orders, progress notes. Provide direct patient care, as required. Perform Point of Care Testing where applicable. Contact physician with any problems or concerns, as necessary. Report changes in patient's condition to physician. Maintain safe, clean and therapeutic environment for patients.

Prepare or assign all required documentation to meet legal requirements and hospital policies and procedures. Maintain appropriate communication with other staff members, patient and family members, including answering questions, discussing patient care and providing emotional support to patients and family.
